name: @w6w-apps/fireberry
description: Read, create, update, delete and query Fireberry CRM records across any object, and read object, field and picklist metadata.

w6w.longDescription:
Fireberry (formerly Powerlink) is a CRM for managing accounts, contacts, opportunities, tasks, support cases and custom objects. This app lists, reads, creates, updates and deletes records of any object, built-in or custom, by system name or object number, fetches related records, and batch-creates or batch-updates up to 20 records at a time.

It searches with Fireberry's v3 query (filters, sorting, grouping and aggregation, up to 500 rows a page) and reads the metadata API: every object, an object's fields, and a picklist field's options.

Health checks verify the API access token, whether api.fireberry.com is answering, and Fireberry's own status page.
